initiatives.name: Newsroom Digital Skills Training
initiatives.description: Training cohorts, a shared digital toolkit and small grants that help independent local newsrooms build digital audiences and sustainable revenue.

toc.inputs: $190k budget including a grant fund; 3 programme staff; trainer network of 12 working journalists; shared analytics and CMS toolkit.
toc.activities: Monthly training cohorts on audience development and revenue; toolkit onboarding and support; small grants for pilots; peer-learning roadshow.
toc.outputs: 300 journalists trained; 40 newsrooms onboarded to the toolkit; 30 newsrooms using audience analytics every week.
toc.outcomes: Newsrooms grow digital audiences, add new revenue streams, and staff apply new skills; local readers trust their local news more.
toc.impact: More local news organisations are financially sustainable, so communities keep access to reliable local reporting.

initiatives.name: Newsroom Champions (internal)
initiatives.description: News-literacy sessions for colleagues, and a champions network who explain the programme and use its stories in their own teams.

toc.inputs: $40k; 1 programme lead; content from the external training; support from Comms and Marketing.
toc.activities: Monthly news-literacy sessions; a champions certification; an internal case-study pack.
toc.outcomes: Colleagues can explain the programme confidently and use its stories with partners and policymakers.
toc.impact: The organisation speaks about news and journalism with one informed voice.

initiatives.name: Newsroom Tools Partnership
initiatives.description: Onboards newsrooms to partner publishing, transcription and analytics tools, with training and support.

toc.inputs: $80k; partner tools at no cost to newsrooms; 1 partnerships manager; support desk.
toc.activities: Newsroom onboarding; monthly tool clinics; integration support.
toc.outputs: 60 partner newsrooms live; 6,000 stories published with the tools.
toc.outcomes: Journalists save time on routine tasks and use the tools every week.
toc.impact: Newsrooms spend more time on original reporting.

initiatives.name: Product Feedback Loop (internal)
initiatives.description: Brings newsroom feedback to internal product teams, so tools are built around real newsroom needs.

toc.inputs: $30k; programme staff time; access to product teams.
toc.activities: Monthly feedback sessions; a shared insights log; newsroom visits for product staff.
toc.outcomes: Product teams use newsroom insights in planning and ship requested features.
toc.impact: The organisation's products serve news organisations better.

initiatives.name: Local News Audience Study
initiatives.description: A large survey of local news audiences, published as short briefs and a full report.

toc.activities: Fieldwork in 6 countries; analysis; briefs and report.
toc.outcomes: Findings are cited by policymakers and press, and used by internal teams.
toc.impact: Decisions about local news are based on evidence.

initiatives.name: Global News Summit 2026
initiatives.description: Two-day summit in November for newsroom leaders, partners and policymakers.

toc.inputs: $55k; venue partner; sponsors; programme and Marketing staff.
toc.activities: Programme design; speaker and sponsor outreach; registration campaign.
toc.outcomes: Attendees rate it highly and start partnerships afterwards.
toc.impact: A stronger network of organisations supporting local news.

initiatives.name: Lunch & Learn series (internal)
initiatives.description: Monthly internal sessions where newsroom partners and programme staff share stories and results with colleagues.

toc.inputs: $15k; Comms support; guest speakers from partner newsrooms.
toc.activities: Monthly lunch-and-learn sessions, in person and online.
toc.outcomes: Colleagues understand the programme and share its stories.
toc.impact: Stronger internal support for the programme.

initiatives.name: Policy Engagement on Local News
initiatives.description: Briefings, consultation responses and roundtables that bring programme evidence to policymakers.

toc.inputs: $30k; GAPP team time; programme data and case studies.
toc.activities: Policymaker briefings; written submissions; roundtables with newsrooms.
toc.outcomes: Programme evidence is cited in policy and officials ask for more.
toc.impact: Policy that supports a sustainable local news sector.

evidence.title: Publisher on sustainability
evidence.body: We're closer, but one big advertiser leaving would still put us back in the red. The grant bought us time to diversify.

evidence.metric: Newsrooms with a new revenue stream
evidence.title: Theme: memberships are the most common new revenue stream
evidence.body: Across 38 check-in responses, memberships (14) and local events (9) were the most-cited new revenue streams. Sentiment is mostly positive, with concern about sustaining member numbers after launch.
evidence.source: AI theme coding of monthly check-in forms

evidence.title: Follow-up survey, cohort 1-3 (n=112)
evidence.body: 64% say they used a technique from training in the last month. Most cited: headline testing (41%), newsletter segmentation (29%), audience surveys (18%).

evidence.title: Reader survey comment
evidence.body: They actually come to the meetings now and explain what the decisions mean for us. That's why I read them.

evidence.metric: Newsrooms with a new revenue stream
evidence.title: Tyneside Tribune launches a membership scheme
evidence.body: After the revenue cohort, the Tribune launched a $5/month membership with a members-only newsletter. 310 members joined in the first six weeks, covering one part-time reporter.

evidence.title: Regional press coverage of the roadshow
evidence.body: Article on the Newsroom Futures roadshow and the programme's aims.

evidence.title: Trainee on newsletter skills
evidence.body: I rebuilt our newsletter the week after the session. Open rates went from 22% to 38%.

evidence.metric: Average monthly digital audience per newsroom
evidence.title: Editor on the analytics dashboard
evidence.body: For the first time we can see which stories people actually finish. We've moved our council coverage to the morning slot and it's our most-read section now.

evidence.title: Policy colleague on the champions session
evidence.body: I used the local newsroom examples in a meeting with a ministry team the following week. Having real numbers made the conversation much easier.

evidence.title: Reporter on automated transcription
evidence.body: Transcribing a council meeting used to take me an evening. Now I have a draft in twenty minutes and spend the time chasing the story.

evidence.title: Q3 user survey (n=146)
evidence.body: NPS rose from 26 to 31. Most common complaint: the analytics tool's setup takes too long without support.

evidence.metric: Citations in policy papers and press
evidence.title: Study cited in national press
evidence.body: Coverage of brief 2 (who pays for local news) in a national newspaper's media section.

evidence.title: Headline finding from brief 2
evidence.body: 62% of local news readers would pay something for local news, but only 14% currently do. Price sensitivity is highest under 35.

evidence.title: Two newsrooms share a data reporter
evidence.body: After meeting at the July roadshow, two county newsrooms now share a data reporter and co-publish investigations.

evidence.metric: Attendees who understand the programme better
evidence.title: Sales colleague after a session
evidence.body: I finally get what the programme does. I've already used the Tyneside membership story with a client.

evidence.title: Adviser in a ministry team
evidence.body: The newsroom case studies were exactly what we needed. Could you send the survey figures by region?

evidence.metric: Programme evidence cited in policy documents
evidence.title: Consultation response on local media
evidence.body: Our written response to the local media consultation, drawing on the audience study and training results.

risks.title: Digital audience growth misses target
risks.description: Audience growth is off track and its leading indicator (weekly analytics use) is behind.
risks.mitigation: One-to-one analytics coaching for the 18 newsrooms not yet using the dashboard weekly.

risks.title: Partner newsrooms drop out before cohort 4
risks.mitigation: Monthly check-ins; grant tranches tied to attendance; peer mentoring pairs.

risks.title: Toolkit vendor price rise at renewal
risks.mitigation: Negotiate a two-year rate; price an alternative supplier by end of September.

risks.title: Data protection issue with shared newsroom analytics
risks.mitigation: Data processing agreements signed with all newsrooms; access reviewed quarterly.

risks.title: Internal budget underspent and returned at year end
risks.mitigation: Extend champions sessions to regional offices from October.

risks.title: Ministry roundtable postponed
risks.mitigation: Prepare a written briefing that can be sent if the meeting slips.

risks.title: Partner changes tool pricing for newsrooms
risks.mitigation: Agree fixed pricing to the end of 2027 in the renewal.

risks.title: Low weekly use means partners lose interest
risks.mitigation: Tool clinics for newsrooms below weekly use; share usage data with partners monthly.

risks.title: Product teams deprioritise newsroom requests
risks.mitigation: Agree two newsroom features per quarter with product leadership.

risks.title: Report launch misses the policy window
risks.mitigation: Publish briefs early and share embargoed findings with GAPP.

risks.title: Summit registrations fall short of 800
risks.mitigation: Phase 2 campaign through partner newsletters; group discounts for newsrooms.

risks.title: Sponsor shortfall leaves a budget gap
risks.mitigation: Scale the online track; approach two additional foundations.

risks.title: Election period limits access to officials
risks.mitigation: Front-load briefings before the pre-election period; focus on officials, not ministers.

decisions.title: Extend champions sessions to regional offices
decisions.decision: Run champions sessions in four regional offices from October.
decisions.rationale: Internal spend is well behind the timeline and demand from regional teams is high.

decisions.title: Report Q2 from a frozen snapshot
decisions.decision: Board and funder reports use the Q2 snapshot, not live figures.
decisions.rationale: Figures shared with the board shouldn't change when late data arrives.

decisions.title: Fund a memberships pilot
decisions.decision: Up to $8k of grant budget goes to five newsrooms piloting memberships.
decisions.rationale: Memberships were the most common new revenue stream; a pilot tests whether support speeds it up.

decisions.title: Move revenue training earlier in each cohort
decisions.decision: Revenue sessions move from week 6 to week 2.
decisions.rationale: Early cohorts said they needed revenue ideas before planning audience work.

decisions.title: Choose the summit city
decisions.decision: The summit will be held in Lisbon, with an online track.
decisions.rationale: Best mix of cost, access for global attendees and a venue partner offering a discount.

decisions.title: Publish research as briefs first
decisions.decision: Findings will be released as six short briefs before the full report.
decisions.rationale: Policy and press interest is highest now; briefs keep the study in the news for longer.

decisions.title: Prioritise transcription over analytics integrations
decisions.decision: Phase 3 integration budget goes to transcription tools.
decisions.rationale: Transcription saves the most time in the user survey; analytics setup needs more support than budget allows.

decisions.title: Lead the consultation response jointly with GAPP
decisions.decision: GAPP leads the consultation response; the programme supplies data and case studies.
decisions.rationale: GAPP owns relationships with officials; the programme owns the evidence.

programme.name: Global News Programme
programme.mission: Help news organisations and the people who work with them build the skills, audiences and support that keep reliable journalism going.
programme.description: A global programme run with Comms, Government Affairs & Public Policy and Marketing, across five focus areas: trainings, product and technology partnerships, research, events, and policy and public affairs.

focusAreas.name: Trainings
focusAreas.description: Skills training for journalists and newsrooms (external), and news-literacy training that turns colleagues into programme champions (internal).

focusAreas.name: Product & Technology Partnerships
focusAreas.description: Free and discounted newsroom tools from product partners, and a feedback loop so product teams build what newsrooms need.

focusAreas.name: Research & Insights
focusAreas.description: Evidence on local news audiences and business models, for newsrooms, policymakers and internal teams.

focusAreas.name: Events & Convenings
focusAreas.description: The flagship summit for newsroom leaders, and internal events that keep colleagues close to the programme.

focusAreas.name: Policy & Public Affairs
focusAreas.description: Working with Government Affairs & Public Policy so programme evidence informs policy on local news.
